ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent conviction of the Director of African American Affairs at Minnesota State University and explore the broader issue of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota
questions: What are the root causes of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can the state prevent further fraud and protect patients?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the need for increased oversight and accountability in the healthcare system.
